title: Chapter 41: Insect Man
content:
Chapter 41: Insect Man

What surprised Wu Qing was that after a lot of fighting, three Hydralisks finally broke through the shackles of strength and reached one star.

A one-star Hydralisks, with a height of more than four meters, looked more majestic and solid, and its attack and defense capabilities were greatly enhanced, and its attack speed and movement speed were also improved to a certain extent.

A one-star Hydralisks could easily deal with ten non-star Hydralisks.

If fighting against bug goblin soldiers, a single shot of spikes could kill an enemy, and the defense capabilities of bug goblin infantry would have no effect on it.

It's like replacing a pistol with a rifle, which greatly increases its power.

One-star enemies will also be seriously threatened, and it will be easier for the Zerg to deal with one-star enemies.

The Zerg has three more powerful long-range attackers. In some special occasions, they will play an important role, but in the large battlefield where the two armies are fighting, their number is too small to play a decisive role.

Unfortunately, the one-star units of the Zerg itself have no effect on the upgrade of the mother nest. If the mother nest wants to upgrade, it needs to kill or conquer 4 one-star creatures.

...

The Zerg worker bees cleaned up the battlefield and the large army began to retreat.

Many scouts from the surrounding native races witnessed part of the process of several battles between the Zerg and the Bugbears.

Regardless of strength, if you can become a lord, you always have some available talents under your command, and there is no shortage of scouts who go out for reconnaissance in broad daylight.

They also sensed the unusual movements around the territory.

Wu Qing selectively let these scouts see some of the scenes, and he needed to convey some information to these native races.

As the Zerg army withdrew, these scouts quickly brought the intelligence they obtained back to their respective territories.

After the war, Wu Qing arranged the general direction of the Zerg's development, and the remaining details were handed over to the Queen.

He now had to make some preparations for the next action plan.

The Zerg's biotechnology was extremely advanced, and Wu Qing had also thought about creating and researching some Zerg arms to enrich the types of Zerg combat units.

After extracting the biological genes of this world for testing, it was found that the comprehensive capabilities of the various arms developed were far behind those of the Zerglings and Hydralisks.

Moreover, the resources consumed increased exponentially, which was really bad and expensive, and completely worthless.

Wu Qing learned from the Queen that all the Zerg arms were formed after countless years of selection, optimization, and elimination, and were verified by countless actual combat.

It is the optimal result of the balance of many aspects such as functions, combat power, and resource consumption. It is not that you can get something valuable by just taking some genes and combining them.

After understanding this, Wu Qing no longer expected to develop many Zerg troops by himself. As long as he could develop some special Zerg units such as biological colonization suits, identity cards and identity authentication spores to meet the development needs of Daxia in this world, he would be satisfied.

But there is one Zerg unit that Wu Qing must develop no matter what the cost, that is the human-shaped Zerg.

At Wu Qing's request, the Queen of Zerg obtained the genes of the human race in this world, and has been combining and optimizing the genes recently.

Wu Qing's requirement is that the appearance should be completely consistent with the humans in this world, but the inside should have as many advantages of the Zerg as possible.

To put it simply, it is a human skin and a worm heart, a Zerg with human appearance.

Wu Qing plans to call this kind of Zerg unit Zergman.

After Wu Qing got some understanding of this world, he found that he could only choose the weaker side of the two opposing camps in this world.

Although the Zerg, a newly emerged race, joined the native race camp, it was not so easy to develop.

Wu Qing was ready to use his human identity to start with the human race, a large tribe among the local races, and develop by taking advantage of the situation.

The Zerg can be mysterious, hiding behind the scenes, only sending troops to participate in the war, and not communicating directly with the local races.

Wu Qing took the Zerg and used the identity of the human race to represent the Zerg, so that there was a lot of room for operation in many things.

Therefore, no matter from which aspect, the Zerg must first be a human, and then consider the ability to merge with the Zerg.

After this period of research, the Queen of the Zerg gave several plans, and Wu Qing finally made up his mind today and chose a plan.

Consuming 100 energy points and 50 gas points to hatch a Zerg, this consumption is much higher than that of the Hydralisk.

Consuming 50 points of gas is to increase their spiritual power, so that they look more like an independent person with the support of the Queen of the Zerg.

Therefore, the upper limit of the Zerg population they occupy is almost negligible.

The standard template of the Zerg is a young male with a height of about 2 meters and a strong body. Their bodies look like humans, and even the internal structure of the body is consistent with the humans in this world.

They were only given some of the Zerg's characteristics at the genetic level, such as strong physique, super strong recovery ability, weapons and shells in the form of biological colonies, etc.

Most importantly, they are Zerg units, group creatures, and the independent personalities they show are all virtual. They are just an insignificant clone of the Zerg group consciousness.

Therefore, they have the Zerg's fighting will and fighting style, and when fighting, they are no different from the Zerg.

They are not intelligent creatures, so Wu Qing has no psychological burden when using them.

The design of the Zerg has been determined. Now that resources are sufficient, Wu Qing hatched 10 Zerg in the Zerg territory.

Not long after, 10 Zerg appeared in front of Wu Qing. Wu Qing asked them to change their biological equipment into the appearance of heavy infantry, and choose knives as weapons.

In this way, they look like ten mighty human heavy infantry.

"You fight each other, don't kill them."

Wu Qing asked the ten Zerg to fight each other.

The ten Zerg drew their swords and fought fiercely. At first, they still followed the restrictions of weapons and equipment. As they fought, their biological equipment changed into various strange things, causing efficient damage to the opponent.

If Wu Qing had not asked not to kill them, half of the Zerg would probably be lying on the ground now.

"The essence of this Zerg is still the Zerg, and even the way of fighting has not changed."

Wu Qing smiled helplessly.

There is no other way. If the Zerg use human skills, it will seriously affect their combat effectiveness. Only the combat skills that the Zerg have accumulated countless times are the most suitable for them.

Now that they have biological colonization suits to cover, it is understandable that the human race uses some strange combat skills.

Perhaps in the near future, after seeing more Zerg-man battles, this efficient combat method of the Zerg will become popular in this world. Who knows.
